sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹3L; schedule-dependent)

room_rent.note: Base eligibility is 1% of SI per day. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' upgrades to Single Private AC Room (only for SI < ₹5L). Policy Schedule may also state Single Private AC Room directly.

icu.note: Base ICU limit is 2% of SI per day. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' upgrades to no limit (only for SI < ₹5L).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional Co-Payment Option (Clause 3.2.6) introduces co-pay for insured aged 61+ as per Policy Schedule. Smart Select optional cover adds 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits (room rent, ICU, ambulance per schedule)
sub_limits.note: Room rent and ICU charges are sub-limited per Policy Schedule. Ambulance and organ donor have schedule-specified limits. No disease-wise monetary sub-limits explicitly listed beyond room/ICU caps.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional add-on (Optional Benefit: Deductible Option, Clause 3.2.5); amount as per Policy Schedule. Base plan has no deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months continuous coverage. Reducible via portability/migration credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, BPH, varicose veins, kidney/gall stones, etc.) have 24-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity & New Born Baby Cover is an optional benefit with 24-month waiting period. Covers delivery, C-section, newborn expenses up to benefit limit. Max 2 living children. Age cap 45 years.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of base SI added per claim-free year (or if claims ≤25% of base SI). Max cumulative bonus capped at 200% of base SI. Bonus reduced if claims exceed 25% of base SI.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates base SI unlimited times per policy year once base SI + Cumulative Bonus + Inflation Shield exhausted. Recharge can be used for same illness too (except Any One Illness condition). Applies to Hospitalization, Pre/Post-hosp, Ambulance, Domiciliary, Maternity benefits.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement are covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to amount in Policy Schedule. Excludes listed conditions: asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, epilepsy, hypertension, influenza, psychiatric disorders, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) in-patient treatment covered up to sum insured as per Policy Schedule, subject to in-patient claim admissibility.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's medical expenses for harvesting surgery covered up to amount in Policy Schedule. Post-harvesting expenses of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance also covered as separate benefit up to schedule limit.

modern_treatments.note: Advance technology methods covered: robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), intra-vitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, stem cell therapy (haematological), bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM. Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, etc.) are listed as excluded in Annexure I. No optional rider for consumables cover mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only. International Second Opinion is available as optional benefit but is not treatment cover.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Enhanced SI has its own 5-year moratorium from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly installment mode. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in installments.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document. Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before renewal date.

notable_exclusions: Consumables/non-medical items (Annexure I), STDs (except HIV-related), hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomalies, domiciliary for listed chronic conditions
optional_riders: Maternity & New Born Cover, Deductible Option, Co-Payment Option (age 61+), Smart Select (network discount), Room Rent Modification, Daily Allowance, International Second Opinion
